policy: A workflow that downloads evidence from another run id accepts it only from a reviewed producer workflow that ran on main in this repository (no forks), finished successfully, and whose head commit is the consuming commit (exact) or one of its ancestors (ancestor). Register a new producer workflow here in a reviewed change before using its run ids. allow_same_run (real-ga-readiness only) additionally accepts an artifact uploaded earlier in the consumer's own workflow run (GITHUB_RUN_ID).

release.description: release.yml imports the bound evidence that an enforced Main Verification run uploaded for the exact commit being released.

main-verification.description: Main Verification binds the clean external-ga-evidence artifact assembled by the control plane or the remote evidence pipeline.

remote-evidence-pipeline.description: Raw provider evidence bundles uploaded by registered producer workflows.

real-ga-readiness.description: Real GA Readiness audits the bound evidence that an enforced Main Verification run uploaded on main. When the control plane calls it with its own github.run_id, the artifact comes from an earlier job of that same in-progress run (allow_same_run), so the run check is skipped; only the expected evidence files are copied either way.

real-ga-evidence-control-plane.description: Provider and staging evidence producers. Release-artifact, AWS Device Farm, live-services and staging-operations producers must be added here once their workflows exist on main.
